messages:
Anya: Heads-up — HF->Redwood conversion for small-llm-3b showed a token mismatch between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json. Fast loader picks tokenizer.json (no <|pad|>), slow loader reads tokenizer_config.json (has <|pad|>), so downstream evals differ.
Sam: Oof. Can you paste the model dir listing and the loader logs?
Anya: Sure — short dir dump:
```
model/  
  config.json
  merges.txt
  tokenizer.json
  tokenizer_config.json
  vocab.json
```
Loader snippet (fast loader):
```
INFO fast_tokenizer: loaded tokenizer.json (vocab-only)
WARN fast_tokenizer: special_tokens not found in tokenizer.json
INFO fallback: using slow_tokenizer for special tokens
```
Loader snippet (slow):
```
INFO slow_tokenizer: read tokenizer_config.json -> special_tokens: {"pad_token":"<|pad|>","eos_token":""}
```
Anya: When fast tokenizer is used in hosted inference it currently returns tokenization that omits pad tokens in some templates; quantized evals show small but consistent quality regression (~0.7% rouge drop) because prompt lengths change.
Mikael: Sounds like a loader-priority mismatch. Our conversion script sometimes writes tokenizer.json from the fast tokenizer exporter but doesn't merge special_tokens_map.json or tokenizer_config.json. Two quick options: 1) Add missing special tokens into tokenizer.json at conversion time; 2) Make loader unify precedence (tokenizer_config.json wins for specials) and emit a clear warning.
Sam: For immediate repro, can you run the token-checker on the model and attach the diff? Command: 
```
python -m redwood.tools.tokencheck --model ./model --cases tests/eval_prompts.jsonl --out token_diff.log
```
Anya: Ran that. Relevant diff excerpt: 
```
case 12: input len fast=128 slow=130 -> decoded mismatch near prompt boundary
case 45: fast missing pad token -> generation offset +1
```
Result: rouge-l -0.72% vs baseline.
Mikael: TL;DR: conversion bug + loader fallback leads to non-deterministic tokenization across runtimes. Fix plan:
- Anya: open PR to update conversion script to merge special_tokens_map into tokenizer.json (small patch).
- Sam: add CI tokencheck that runs both fast and slow loaders and asserts identical token counts on our eval prompts.
- Mikael: change loader to prefer tokenizer_config.json for special tokens and log a clear error when files disagree.
token-bot: conversion-job-98321 finished for small-llm-3b (status: success) :information_source:
Anya: I'll push the conversion PR now and link tests. Leaving a note to ops: if you see a spike in small-llm-3b eval false-negatives, this is probably the cause. :point_up:
